sources.claim: VSLive 2026 hackathon ran over two evenings (4-hour blocks), in-person only, with prizes up to $25,000 and five project categories

sources.title: How to Form a Winning Hackathon Team
sources.claim: Diverse teams with distinct skill sets perform better; pre-event matching by skill profile beats on-the-day random assignment

sources.title: How to Organize a Hackathon in 2026
sources.claim: Distribute starter kits and API docs at least one week before the event; use milestone emails to reduce no-shows

sources.claim: HackerEarth integrates coding assessments directly into competition workflows; Devpost excels at enterprise-scale reliability

sources.claim: VLANs give each team or segment its own private network, preventing one team's bandwidth-heavy AI agent loop from starving others
